Local flightsim modifications, 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09

Modified source paths: src/render/parallax_mapping.wgsl (original ray intersection replacement), src/meshlet/mod.rs (documentation-only preview omission note); src/meshlet/meshlet_preview.png is omitted, with no runtime or meshlet-feature change.
src/render/forward_io.wgsl additionally uses perspective-centroid interpolation for world position, world normal and vertex color only when the terrain material supplies FLIGHTSIM_TERRAIN_CENTROID. Ordinary materials and prepass IO retain their existing interpolation. This render-only modification changes no mesh, DEM, physics, MSAA setting or PBR lighting model.
The existing parallax function replacement and its regression tests retain their previously documented scope. The centroid shader modification intentionally changes boundary interpolation; no byte, pixel or original-behavior equivalence is claimed for it. Project-authored modifications use the existing MIT OR Apache-2.0 terms. Upstream copyrights, licence texts and retained-code notices are preserved. Exact original-source hashes, modifications and authoring limitations are in FLIGHTSIM-UPSTREAM-SOURCE.json and FLIGHTSIM-PATCHES.md. No upstream endorsement, human authorship or new upstream licence grant is asserted.
